	local returning = nil

            warn("Failed to get "..URL)

1 thing i'd recommend doing is not putting it in your autoexecute when you're using it for the first time. What you wanna do is load up with no script, redeem all the spin codes and ****, and then leave so it can save. Afterwards you can load up with the script and see if the spins are there.

The reason for this is that if you load up with the script and use the codes, when you rejoin, you'll be set back to however many spins you started with and you can't reuse the codes which sucks straight *******.
